steps.prompt:
Create a NEW Chinese desktop space-idle game concept from the updated design. One full-window 1440x900 work canvas, target LEFT module 808px (56.11%) and fixed RIGHT reference battlefield632px (43.89%). Reference1 is the original full-window split/style and right battlefield. Replace its left equipment view completely; retain right battlefield solely as context without designing new ships, shields, combat geometry or P3/demo labels. Reference2 supplies only the existing planet/space visual identity and orbit scene style; its facility placement and floating scene labels are now OBSOLETE.

References3/4 are actual facility silhouettes: refinery TWO HORIZONTAL cream/ochre cylindrical tanks beside a teal center; workshop a compact cream PRESS with ochre horizontal overhang/upright and teal plinth. Reference5 actual station: compact ivory hub, cyan top, TWO broad solid BLUE wings, no antenna forest or fine solar grids. Use existing recognizable shapes. Shipyard identity is the open U-shaped ivory cradle visible in reference2.

USER-CONFIRMED DESIGN:
The space station ORBITS in space. The RESOURCE REFINERY is physically ON THE PLANET SURFACE, fixed to the same landmass and rotating with that land. Buildings are ONLY FOR WATCHING AND STATE APPEARANCE. ALL operations are separate in a STABLE observation console. NO clicking buildings, NO action buttons or floating labels attached to buildings, NO leader lines from buildings to buttons, NO selection halos or cursor icons on scene objects. A building can pass behind the planet without moving/hiding any controls.
For this proposed composition, workshop is also on land and shipyard is a fixed near-orbit dock; these two are design suggestions, not user-confirmed placement. Do not add the word "建议" inside product UI; proposal status will be explained outside the image.

ENTIRE LEFT MODULE is one coherent planet observation environment plus its integrated edge console, NOT a globe inset into a card or generic dashboard.
Global masthead at y0..60 warm ivory, compact navigation y60..100, full-bleed continuous low-saturation deep teal/blue-gray orbit space y100..650, shallow warm ivory observation console y650..900 extending full left width. NO inner frame around the globe, no rounded scene container, no individual building cards. Quiet sparse stars, NO asteroids. Keep the established gentle ivory, dark teal, sage/cyan and restrained amber relationships. Sharp readable Chinese.

SCENE spatial requirements:
Globe center about (375,365), diameter about370px. Full body visible, real breathing room for orbit paths. Same recognizable broad teal oceans and pale cream/olive cel continents as reference2, no new realistic geography or noisy terrain. Sparse independent white cloud bands. Fixed upper-left lighting, gradual darker lower-right shading, restrained rim rather than a bright neon ring.
Refinery on the broad LOWER-FRONT LANDMASS, near (380,430). Small but readable actual two-horizontal-tank model, about35-45 client pixels wide. Its base MUST visibly rest flush on terrain, with a short contact shadow and local tangent-plane tilt. It is NOT a flat icon, sticker, floating hologram, or free-orbit model projected over water. Show tiny muted amber readiness beacon only; no production plume, no “领取” button in the scene.
Workshop on another LAND patch toward the LEFT limb near (225,325), visibly grounded, compressed/tilted with the local tangent and partly masked near the planetary edge. It is the same cream/ochre press silhouette, approximately25-35px visible. Do not keep it screen-facing as the planet turns. No label/tooltip/button by it.
Space station on a separate upper-left orbital arc outside the globe, near (170,235), recognizable two broad solid blue wings, about60px wide. It floats in orbital space, not on land. Front/back path is clear, faint rear arc vanishes behind globe where overlapping. No station text by the station.
Shipyard in near-orbital space toward lower-right (625,470), fixed station position, open U-shaped UNFINISHED muted scaffold/structure, about60px wide. It does not sit on the surface and does not orbit for this suggestion. No action or callout next to it.
Small ivory/navy scout on front right-lower orbit segment around(600,530), bow tangent to path and a short restrained wake. NO task readout beside ship; task facts belong to console.
Keep orbital arcs sparse and physically front/back layered, not a decorative cage. Scene buildings have no permanent text labels.

STABLE CONTROL CONSOLE, integrated across full left lower edge y650..900:
One continuous warm ivory instrument surface, no nested cards. Use thin horizontal separators only, concise dark teal type, actual states and ordinary fixed controls. Four facility rows are a compact operations ledger, NOT separate framed cards, and do not wrap the globe.
First task row around y665: “探索中  ·  探索者 1 人  ·  本次进度 68%”, a small fixed “人员” button, teal “本次完成后停止” button, and physically separated quiet “立即取消探索”. A small separate fact “自动探索 · 开启”. No duplicate auto toggle, no explanatory tutorial.
Then a compact table at y715..850 with columns "设施 / 当前状态 / 操作", tiny matching model icons optional:
“空间站”   “已领取”             no action needed
“精炼厂”   “待领取”             amber fixed “领取” button
“工坊”     “已领取”             no action needed
“船坞”     “施工中 38 / 180 次 · 施工人员 1 / 1”    fixed “人员” button
Keep all row names/status/actions legible, no clipped Chinese. No fabricated costs, rates, buffs, active refinery production, or construction seconds. No inaccurate construction progress bar; count38/180 is sufficient.
Bottom edge contains compact “累计加成” and disabled “重铸预览”, reason “船坞未领取”. Console stays fixed when buildings rotate/occlude. It must feel like the observation scene's functional console, not a second unrelated app.

TOP LEFT edge furniture:
“远航舰桥” with small icon, resources “铁128.6M  铀8.4M  碎片2.1K”, status “交战中”, small “暂停”.
Compact navigation “装备  反应炉  科研  船员  星球  星系”, 星球 selected.
At scene upper-left around(25,128): “始源星 E178b”, “探索度 68”, previous/next selectors. No degree percentage bar.

This is the t=0 scene design with built station/workshop, ready-but-unclaimed refinery, and building shipyard38/180, explorer1/extra builder1. Planet surface attachment, cloud independence and fixed lighting may be implemented using either analytic sphere shader or sphere mesh; do not choose or advertise a renderer.
No design explanations, recommendations, timestamps or layer diagrams in the product UI. No interaction affordances on buildings. Full window edge to edge, no laptop frame or outside margin.

Create ONE wide three-panel TEMPORAL DESIGN STORYBOARD of the LEFT planetary module in reference1. It is a design illustration, NOT real gameplay footage or an implemented animation. Three equal vertical panels, same scene/camera/crop/light/planet center/scale and stable console. Do not include the right battlefield. Nominal three module rectangles808x900 with an external annotation strip above; do not invent three alternate redesigns.

Outside the product UI only, add two concise annotation lines:
“地表/轨道与独立操作 · 非实机动画”
“未暂停 · 1× · 人员持续在岗；工坊地表、船坞近轨为建议”
Outside each product view label “t = 0 游戏秒”, “t = 4 游戏秒”, “t = 8 游戏秒”.
No technical labels, arrows, timestamps or explanation inside the product view.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Reference1 is the EXACT proposed t0 scene and control composition. Use only its LEFT module, with the globe, refinery and workshop ON LAND, independently orbiting station, stationary near-orbit scaffold shipyard, scout, and stable lower operations console. Preserve these identities and their relative scale.
References2/3 show the same OLD GAME globe after4/8 seconds, ONLY to guide coherent sphere-map movement under fixed lighting, not their old interface.
Reference4 = actual two-horizontal-tank refinery silhouette, reference5 = actual cream/ochre press workshop. Keep the same models, not flat floating icons.

CRITICAL NEW USER REQUIREMENTS:
Buildings are ONLY visual/status objects. ALL actions/readouts remain in the same fixed bottom console in every panel. NO clickable scene objects, no labels/buttons/leader lines/selection halos attached to buildings. Surface buildings stay fixed to the SAME continental patches as the globe turns. They must tilt and foreshorten on the local tangent, with bases touching land/contact shadow, and gradually disappear behind the limb when appropriate. They do not remain screen-facing stickers, do not float above water/clouds, and do not acquire independent orbital motion.

All panels use the SAME broad continent geography, sparse cloud bands, subdued atmosphere, upper-left fixed light and darker lower-right shading. The planet's outer contour and lighting gradient remain fixed. Clouds move independently by a slightly different longitude phase, while buildings follow LAND, not clouds. No new continents or random relocating buildings.

t0 panel: match reference1's t0 positions. Ready refinery is the compact two horizontal tanks ON the central lower-front landmass, with muted amber readiness beacon, no plume. Built workshop is the grounded press ON the left continent. Station is an ivory hub with two broad solid blue wings in orbital space upper-left. Scaffold U-shaped shipyard stays in lower-right nearby space. Scout front right-lower arc. Degree68 and construction38/180, builder1/1, explorer1. Bottom task reads68%.
t4 panel: globe surface shifts LEFT about8.6 degrees of longitude; clouds shift about10.5 degrees from t0, SMALL relative drift. The very SAME lower-front landmass carries the refinery a modest distance LEFT. Its footpoint stays on the same patch; its visible top/side/base perspective changes with the planet's tangent. Workshop moves LEFT with its original continent, nearer the limb and more compressed, still grounded. Do NOT simply translate the same upright icon. Station follows its independent orbital path, different from land rotation. Dock remains at the same fixed screen position. Scout moves along the same front orbital ellipse to lower-left. ALL bottom controls are unmoved, task reads75%, degree68, construction38/180, builder1/1.
t8 panel: surface shift about17.3 degrees from t0, clouds about21 degrees. Same geography and anchors continue. Refinery further left on that SAME lower-front patch, perspective/ground contact still coherent, no teleport. Workshop is visibly narrower/turned near the left limb, with gradual partial occlusion where its footprint intersects the sphere silhouette; do not force an arbitrary full disappearance or jump to a new site. Keep ground building bases attached and lighting fixed. Station continues independently in orbit, can be partly hidden at the planet limb. Scout reaches the rear orbital segment and its occluded portions disappear behind the planet, never a complete ship sticker on a continent. Dock stays fixed. The stable console remains fully accessible and reads task81%, degree68, construction38/180, builder1/1.

The task is60 seconds and started at68% elapsed; no exploration completes within8 game seconds, so degree and construction counts stay unchanged. Refinery remainsready/unclaimed, station/workshop remainbuilt, dockbuilding. No real income, construction or claim animation is demonstrated.

Repeat this FIXED independent console from reference1 in all three panels, consistent and readable:
Top task row “探索中 · 探索者1人 · 本次进度68%/75%/81%” plus fixed “人员”, “本次完成后停止”, “立即取消探索”, fact “自动探索·开启”.
Four compact rows on one warm ivory continuous surface, NOT four cards:
空间站 / 已领取
精炼厂 / 待领取 / fixed amber领取 button
工坊 / 已领取
船坞 / 施工中38/180次 · 施工人员1/1 / fixed人员 button
Bottom累计加成 and disabled重铸预览, reason船坞未领取. Buttons never follow buildings. No duplicate automatic toggle.

The storyboard explains grounding and differential motion at approximate design level; no need to claim pixel-perfect cloud drift or renderer implementation. No change to game rules, no choice of shader-versus-mesh route. Preserve warm/deep-teal visual language and continuous unframed space.
